input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 meets the preferred position on both elements: there is expressly no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and Customer pays only for Services it orders under an executed Order Form, with non-ordering expressly not a breach or shortfall. Section 12.3 reinforces this by confirming Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, and Section 7.1 bars Vendor from imposing unstated minimum-use charges. Searches for minimum, commitment, volume, take-or-pay, shortfall, downgrade and prepaid language across the Order Form (§4), Fees (§7) and Term and Renewal (§8) provisions found no take-or-pay, volume floor, or no-downgrade-at-renewal mechanic; renewal quantities are within Customer's control under §8.2. No redline is required.
